verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework. A framework's tooling could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows none. What it does document is support for external agents: a scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown docs routes, and /llms-full.txt for agent consumption. These are adjacent aids for third-party agents, not a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
